entry.title: CUA-Lite: An Open Platform for Computer Use Agents
entry.summary: CUA-Lite unifies environment interfaces, supervised data formats and per-model harnesses for evaluation, reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning across desktop, browser and mobile tasks.

entry.title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
entry.summary: FocusGUI learns step-specific weights over screenshot, audio, video and interaction-context channels, injecting a compact residual into a frozen decoder without pruning its inputs.

entry.title: VeriCUA: Learning Proactive Verification for Reliable GUI Agent Rewards
entry.summary: VeriCUA trains a Judge to select verification checks and stopping decisions while a frozen Probe inspects the post-task GUI. Single-attempt reinforcement learning balances verdict correctness and Probe use.

entry.title: ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents
entry.summary: ScopeMem conditions latent-memory prefixes on a frozen GUI agent's initial action and trains them to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. Its evaluation separates action repairs from harmful revisions.

entry.title: Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs
entry.summary: Tandem serves hybrid GUI-agent models on Android NPUs using divergence-point state checkpoints, rollback-aware speculative decoding and idle power release between request bursts.

entry.title: Comparing Computer Use Behavior Across Multiple Levels of Abstraction
entry.summary: MAP annotates computer-use traces at linked operation, function/consequence, method and goal levels, then compares human and agent workflows through sequence, pattern and effort metrics.

entry.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
entry.summary: WildAWM synthesizes resettable GUI/MCP/CLI environments and cross-interface tasks, using execution-based checks of solvability, difficulty and verifier consistency before supervised and reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Beyond Next-Screen Prediction: The Decision Value of GUI World Models
entry.summary: Separates next-screen prediction from action evaluation in GUI lookahead and trains Direct Action Ranking on reference actions, comparing prediction-augmented scoring under matched offline supervision.

entry.title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
entry.summary: PersonaCUABench varies simulated user requests and clarification dialogue over fixed web tasks, comparing task completion with requirement handling and persona-agent satisfaction ratings.

entry.title: Adaptation of Computer Use Agents to New Software with User Manuals
entry.summary: MAGE retrieves software-manual sections into fixed execution plans and generates setup/main task-plan pairs whose GUI rollouts support application-specific policy adaptation with round-based GRPO.

entry.title: MobileJailBench: Red Queen Jailbreak Benchmarking for Mobile Agents
entry.summary: MobileJailBench evaluates mobile-agent jailbreaks in a browser-based Android-like simulator, combining feedback-driven attack evolution, separately admitted task expansions and evidence-grounded outcome adjudication.

entry.title: MobileInject: Evaluating Reasoning-to-Action Security of MLLM-Based Mobile Agents under Cross-Modal Consistency Injection
entry.summary: MobileInject evaluates visual/textual observation injection in stateful Android workflows using resettable emulators, benign/adversarial state oracles and trace-based diagnosis of emitted rationales and actions.

entry.title: SPIDES: Information-Flow Control for Browser Agents
entry.summary: SPIDES propagates HTML integrity and confidentiality labels into agent context and mediates browser actions with information-flow policies and approval gates, evaluated in the labeled MicroNet ecosystem.

entry.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
entry.summary: Introduces an open generalist computer-use stack combining visual and programmatic interaction, with model-controlled observation and task-state decisions.

entry.title: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
entry.summary: Trains native computer-use models to coordinate GUI actions and code execution using hybrid demonstrations and online reinforcement learning.

entry.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Uses weak-agent uncertainty to decide when to escalate to a stronger model and monitor its subsequent task execution.

entry.title: Don't Retrain, Remix: Adaptation of Web Agents using Mixture Hypernetworks
entry.summary: WebMix uses a scout-produced interface manual to route mixtures of source-trained LoRA adapters for web agents, adapting to target interfaces without target-time gradient updates.

entry.title: Not All Graphs Are Maps: A Task-Agnostic Exploration Framework for Mobile GUI Navigation
entry.summary: TAG-Nav supplies Android GUI agents with destination and route memory distilled from offline app exploration. DestBench measures arrival at a reference pre-action screen, separately from downstream task execution.

entry.title: What It Is, Not What It Says: Securing Agentic Browsing Interactions with Web Semantics
entry.summary: Intact records webpage element provenance and capabilities, isolates planning per element, and uses a browser harness to constrain actions and request consent for third-party interactions.

entry.title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
entry.summary: Surveys multimodal memory using representation and management axes, distinguishing fixed-policy updates from policy evolution and comparing GUI memory evaluation with other modalities.

entry.title: MMA-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Agent Safety Evaluation
entry.summary: Builds trajectory-guided visual-injection tests for web, desktop and mobile observations, separating target-matching action predictions from broader semantic compromise.

entry.title: Teaching Agents in their Own Style: Blackbox Teacher Distillation for Web Agents
entry.summary: Introduces WebKD, which repairs failed student web-agent trajectories with minimal teacher edits and trains on corrections that preserve the student's reasoning style.

entry.title: How GUI Agents Fail: GraceBench for Execution Stability Diagnosis
entry.summary: Introduces GraceBench, using application transition graphs and recorded interaction evidence to diagnose deviations, loops, and recovery that final task-success scores can hide.

entry.title: Task-State Governance: A Virtual Machine for Verifiable and Recoverable GUI Agent Execution
entry.summary: Presents TaskVM, an interface for specifying desired and preserved application state, checking agent actions, and exposing whether changes can be reversed or compensated.

entry.title: Why Generate a Click? Plug-in Decision Heads for Web Agents
entry.summary: Adds decision heads to a frozen vision-language generator for selecting web actions and targets, with a confidence gate that falls back to text generation.

entry.title: STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces STP-GUI, which selects spatially coherent screenshot windows conditioned on the instruction to reduce visual tokens while retaining useful interface structure.

entry.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
entry.summary: Extends computer-use policies to game control through synthetic training environments and richer keyboard and pointer actions. Its evaluation concerns games rather than ordinary productivity workflows.

entry.title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
entry.summary: Unifies GUI evaluation, trajectory collection, environment synthesis, and online reinforcement learning across mobile, computer, and web tasks.

entry.title: ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation
entry.summary: ECHOES learns recursive textual task memory through privileged screenshot-history distillation and GRPO, then predicts GUI actions from the current screenshot and memory.

entry.title: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
entry.summary: Benchmarks agents creating editable Blender projects through shell, Python and MCP tools, judging delivered scenes with multi-view renders, task-specific rubrics and visual-quality ratings.

entry.title: Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents
entry.summary: Groups GUI trajectories by subgoal and combines action-level and group-level assessments into intermediate rewards for training agents with sparse task outcomes.

entry.title: MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search
entry.summary: Introduces MHVF, a training-free grounding method that explores several candidate screen regions, verifies them in local views, and uses those checks to guide further search.

entry.title: Interaction-as-a-Judge
entry.summary: Uses computer-use agents to interact with generated applications, studying whether interaction improves preference judging, requirement checks, and feedback for application generation.

entry.title: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces SwitchMem, which chooses a textual or visual representation of retrieved experience at each GUI interaction step instead of fixing one memory modality for a task.

entry.title: WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution
entry.summary: Synthesizes resettable workspaces with files, application observations and skills; repairs environment incompatibilities and trains long-task agents using verifier-linked turn credit.

entry.title: Towards Safe Autonomy for Computer Use
entry.summary: Presents SA-CUA, separating trusted and untrusted visual content using accessibility-derived masking rules and a controlled channel for verifying information before endorsement.

entry.title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
entry.summary: Pairs factual probes with next-action choices on frozen agent traces, including Mind2Web, to diagnose reading-decision gaps without closed-loop execution.

entry.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
entry.summary: Introduces CarryOn, which maintains evidence-linked task objects and remaining-work context across history compression, with evaluations on desktop tasks and web research.

entry.title: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
entry.summary: Introduces ScreenRef screenshot grounding data and a training sequence from supervised learning through teacher-guided distillation to reinforcement learning for GroundGUI-8B.

entry.title: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
entry.summary: Introduces CLASHarness, generating verifiable computer-use tasks with conflicting agent reports, shared-state constraints, and coordination requirements to evaluate conflict detection and resolution.

entry.title: Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding
entry.summary: Recasts GUI grounding as predicting a mask of valid click locations from bounding-box supervision, then derives a click point with a deterministic selection rule.

entry.title: HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks
entry.summary: Introduces HyWe, which switches between information search and browser operation within one trajectory, alongside a demonstration pipeline and a benchmark of hybrid web tasks.

entry.title: Learn from Move: the Next Step for GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces LatentGUIWorld to test learning interface semantics and dynamics through interaction, and studies finer movement actions with intermediate visual feedback and exploration demonstrations.

entry.title: PrivacyGuard: Source-Linked Sanitization and Locally Resolvable PII References for Cloud GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces PrivacyGuard, which sanitizes source-linked personal information and maintains locally resolvable references across mobile-agent turns to reduce exposure to remote planners.

entry.title: BrowseSafe++: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detection Across Web Contexts, Languages, and Browser Views
entry.summary: Extends BrowseSafe with paired attacked and clean webpages in several representations, and studies text and screenshot detectors plus feedback-adapted prompt injections.

entry.title: From Observations to Authorized Actions: Measuring Source Information in Android Agents
entry.summary: Measures source-attribution limits in Android accessibility and separately tests application-history and selected-WebView-object checks for authorizing AppFunctions actions.

entry.title: Visible but Not Avoided: State-Dependent Re-Proposal of Rejected Candidates in Catalog-Based LLM Optimization Loops
entry.summary: Studies repeated rejected edits while optimizing a screenshot-only GUI agent, contrasting static probes with reached loop states and testing how rejection wording changes subsequent edit proposals.

entry.title: The Agent Clicks Approve: Injected Page Text Makes Browser Agents Authorize Access the Task Never Named
entry.summary: Studies prompt-injected account-access approvals in browser agents and proposes a service-side authority envelope that checks authorization requests against the user task before allowing them to complete.

entry.title: When Charts Deceive Web Agents: A Paired Benchmark for Misleading Visualization-Grounded Tasks
entry.summary: Introduces MisVisAgentBench, a paired executable benchmark that changes chart evidence while holding web tasks fixed, to trace how misleading visualizations affect agent decisions and downstream actions.

entry.title: CaptchaAgent: Verifiable Visual Reasoning for CAPTCHA Solving
entry.summary: Presents CaptchaAgent, which builds an explicit visual representation of objects and relations, refines ambiguous regions, and checks counterfactual consistency before acting on interactive CAPTCHAs.
